title: Abandoned Tumerok Site
subtitle: Olthoi Harvester grind, level 20, no quest
steps: In the Facility Hub, take the level 15 portal to the Abandoned Tumerok Site.

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Olthoi Harvesters take only 0.25 acid and 0.4 electric, and 0.75 slash, fire and cold. Pierce and bludgeon do full damage, so use those.

notes.title: Exits
notes.body: One Surface Exit is beside the entrance. The other is at the far south-east end, deeper down.
